title.en: The Morning Star is the Evening Star

hint.zh: 接好两根线，元件上会把每个「晨星」框出来：点一下框，那一处就换成「昏星」。
hint.en: Once both wires are in, the part boxes each “the Morning Star”: tick a box and that one becomes “the Evening Star”.

t.zh: 古人以为清晨和黄昏天边的亮星是两颗，后来才知道都是金星。两个名字指同一样东西，写作 =：。
t.en: The ancients took the bright star of dawn and the one of dusk for two; later they learned both are Venus. Two names for one thing are written =: .

t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref>声明的相等带来两块元件：<part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>接进 s = t 和一句提到 s 的话，在元件上把每个 s 框出来，点选的几处换成 t；<part-ref to="part:refl"></part-ref>直接给出 t = t。
t.en: The equality declared in <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref> brought two parts: <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref> takes s = t and a sentence about s, boxes each s on the part, and replaces the ticked ones by t; <part-ref to="part:refl"></part-ref> gives t = t at once.
